name: Adapt and Thrive
game_text: When Attacked, Defend by rolling your single [Power] die. Also Boost yourself with the result of that die.

name: Diversity through Adversity
game_text: On your turn, whenever you Attack a target you haven’t dealt damage to yet this scene, also Boost yourself using your Max die.

name: Efficient Reconfiguration
game_text: Lower two of your powers by one die size each. Increase one of your other powers to . Then take a basic action using that power.

name: Initiate Upgrade Procedure
game_text: Boost using [power] and use your Max die. Attack with your Mid die. Defend with your Min die.

name: Powerful Imitation
game_text: Use an action ability of one of your allies.

name: The Pain of Perfection
game_text: Take irreducible damage. Increase all your powers by one die size each until the end of the scene. Adaptive

name: Behold My Immortal Glory
game_text: Hinder using [power] against multiple targets and use your Max die. Attack each using your Mid+Min dice.

name: From Before Space and Time
game_text: Take 1 irreducible damage to reroll a dice pool of someone Attacking or Hindering you.

name: Immortal Vitality
game_text: If you would be reduced to 0 Health and you don’t have a penalty, roll your single [power] die and become that Health.

name: Ideal Action
game_text: Take a basic action using [quality] and use your Max die.

name: Out of Time
game_text: Boost yourself using [power]. If there are any heroes with their Health in the Yellow zone, use your Mid+Min dice. If there are any heroes with their Health in the Red zone, use your Max+Mid+Min dice.

name: Unknowable Pain
game_text: Attack using [power] and use your Max die. Hinder a target dealt damage this way using your Max+Min dice. Ancient

name: Bust Their Heads
game_text: Attack two nearby targets using [power], using your Max die against one and your Mid+Min against the other. If either target Defends against the Attack, the Defend works against both attacks.

name: Cruel and Unusual
game_text: Whenever you or your nearby allies Hinder, increase the penalty created by 1.

name: Crush the Small
game_text: Attack using [power] and use your Max die. Defend against all Attacks from that target using your Mid die until the start of your next turn.

name: Injured Tantrum
game_text: Attack using [power] and use your Max die. Also Hinder that target: if the target has a or less status die, use your Max+Min dice; if the target has a status die, use your Max die; and if the target has larger than a , use your Mid die.

name: Punish Weakness
game_text: Boost yourself using [power]. If there are any heroes with their Health in the Yellow zone, use your Mid+Min dice. If there are any heroes with their Health in the Red zone, use your Max+Mid+Min dice.

name: Thick
game_text: Reduce all damage dealt to you by 2. Bully

name: Harvest their Power
game_text: When one of your minions is destroyed, roll its die and you recover that much Health.

name: Retributive Lash
game_text: When one of your minions is destroyed, roll its die and deal damage equal to that roll to another target.

name: Powerful Ally
game_text: Use [power/quality] to create a lieutenant of the same die size as your Max die.

name: Shared Power
game_text: Boost one of your minions using [power] and use your Max die. If it is your only minion, also Boost yourself using your Mid die. If not, Boost each of your other minions using your Min die.

name: Summon Mob
game_text: Use [power/quality] to create a number of minions equal to the value of your Max die. The starting die size for those minions is the same as the size of your Min die.

name: Swarm Attack
game_text: Attack using [power] and use your Max die, with a bonus equal to the number of minions you control. Creator 5 Dampening

name: Capitalize on their Failure
game_text: When a nearby hero that you can see invokes a twist, roll your [power] die as a Hinder against them.

name: Curse of Weakness
game_text: Hinder using [power] and use your Max die; that penalty is persistent and exclusive. As long as that penalty is on the target, reduce their highest power die of your choice by one die size. Attack using your Mid die.

name: Field of Woe
game_text: Hinder multiple targets using [power]. While a hero has this penalty, reduce all their power dice by one size.

name: Nullifying Backlash
game_text: When Attacked by a hero with a penalty, ignore their damage and remove a penalty on that hero.

name: Scrambling Strike
game_text: Attack using [power]. Reduce all the target’s quality dice by one size until your next turn.

name: Terror of Inadequacy
game_text: Attack using [quality] and use your Max die. Hinder each opponent that can see or hear the target of your Attack using your Min die.

name: Beneficial Chaos
game_text: Hinder using [power]. Use your Max die. Recover using your Min+Mid dice.

name: Covering Fire
game_text: Hinder multiple targets using [quality]. You and any nearby allies Defend using your Max die.

name: Enraging Touch
game_text: Attack using [power]. Use your Max die. A target dealt damage this way Attacks an ally by rolling their single largest power die.

name: Heedless Explosion
game_text: Attack multiple targets using [quality]. Use your Min die. Hinder each target with your Max die. If one of those targets rolls doubles on their next turn, they take damage equal to the penalty.

name: Painful Disruption
game_text: When Attacked by a hero with a penalty, that hero takes damage equal to the size of that penalty.

name: Taste the Madness
game_text: Whenever a target takes a Hinder action against you, you may first roll your [power] die as a Hinder on them. Disruptive 7 Focused

name: Elemental Absorption
game_text: When Attacked with [energy/element], recover that amount of Health instead of taking damage. When Hindered with [energy/ element], Boost yourself instead.

name: Defensive Charging
game_text: Defend yourself using [power]. This Defend lasts until your next turn. If an Attack deals more damage than the Defend’s value, end the Defend and Attack the attacker equal to the Defend.

name: Perfect Alignment
game_text: Ignore all damage from [energy/element].

name: Pour it On
game_text: Attack one target using [power]. Use your Max die. That target cannot Defend or use reactions against this Attack. Attack multiple other nearby targets using your Min die.

name: Sympathetic Shield
game_text: Defend against an Attack against only you by rolling your single [power] die. Boost yourself by the damage reduced.

name: Vicious Entanglement
game_text: Hinder one target using [power]. Use your Max die. Attack that target using your Mid die.

name: Bodyguard
game_text: When an ally is Attacked, Defend them by rolling your single [power] die. Boost yourself by that amount.

name: Dependable
game_text: Whenever you roll a 1 on a die, reroll that die once.

name: Heavy Hitter
game_text: Attack using [quality]. Use your Max die. Recover Health equal to your Min die.

name: Stalwart Combatant
game_text: Boost using [power]. Use your Max die. Defend with your Mid die.

name: Tough Customer
game_text: Reduce physical and energy damage dealt to you by 1 if the scene is in the Green zone, 2 in the Yellow zone, or 3 in the Red zone.

name: Wracking Aura
game_text: Hinder multiple nearby targets using [power]. Boost yourself using your Max die. 9 Leech

name: Hypnotic Gaze
game_text: When Attacked, Defend yourself by rolling your single [power] die. If this negates the Attack entirely, Hinder that target and Boost yourself with that same die roll.

name: Life Drain
game_text: Attack using [power/quality]. Use your Max die. Hinder that target with your Mid die. Recover Health equal to your Min die.

name: Power Consumption
game_text: When a bonus is used against you in an Attack or Hinder, you may first destroy that bonus. If you do, roll your single [power] die and Recover Health equal to the roll plus the destroyed bonus.

name: Siphoning Wither
game_text: Hinder using [power]. Use your Max+Min dice. Boost with your Mid die.

name: Unnerving Whispers
game_text: Hinder multiple targets using [power]. Recover Health equal to your Min die. If you roll doubles, also Attack one of those targets using your Max die.

name: Violent Vitality
game_text: Attack using [power]. Use your Max die. Boost with your Min die. This bonus is persistent and exclusive.

name: Exploit Weakness
game_text: Attack one hero using [quality]. Hinder all heroes using your Max die.

name: Reversal of Fortune
game_text: When Attacked, Boost yourself using the attacker’s Max die.

name: Prepared for Anything
game_text: At the start of your turn, if you have no bonuses in play, roll your single [quality] die as a Boost for yourself.

name: Villainous Monologue
game_text: Hinder all opponents that can see or hear you using [quality]. Boost yourself using your Max die.

name: Deadly Blink
game_text: Attack multiple nearby targets using [quality]. Then, end up wherever you want in the scene.

name: Defensive Dash
game_text: When Attacked, Defend yourself by rolling for your single [quality] die. Boost yourself with the amount of damage reduced.

name: Fade From Sight
game_text: If you take an action on your turn that does not involve an Attack or Hinder, also use your Min die to Defend against all Attacks against you until your next turn.

name: Sever the Tendons
game_text: Attack using [quality]. Hinder that target using your Max+Min dice.

name: Do Not Dare to Touch Me
game_text: When Attacked, Defend yourself by rolling your single [power] die. Deal that much damage to a different nearby target.

name: Face My Full Might
game_text: Attack using [power]. Use your Max+Mid+Min dice. Hinder yourself using your Max die. Take damage equal to your Mid+Min dice.

name: Fear My Overwhelming Power
game_text: Hinder using [power] and use your Max die. Attack that target using your Mid+Min dice.

name: Raw Power
game_text: Whenever you roll a 1, reroll that die.

name: My Power
game_text: Attack multiple targets using [power] and use your Max die. Hinder each target using your Mid die.

name: Later
game_text: Attack one target using [power/quality]. Use your Max+Min dice. Defend against all Attacks against you by all other targets until the start of your next turn with your Mid die. My Greatness Cannot

name: Be Denied
game_text: Attack one target using [power/quality] and use your Max+Min dice. If that Attack causes the target to change zones, Boost using your Mid die. That bonus is persistent and exclusive.

name: Sustained Mockery
game_text: Hinder using [power/quality]. Use your Max die. That penalty is persistent and exclusive.

name: Unquestionable Might
game_text: Reduce all damage dealt to you by 2.

name: You Cannot Survive
game_text: If an opponent ends their turn near you, you may roll your single [power] die as a Hinder against them. Prideful Relentless

name: Dogged Pursuit
game_text: When an opponent moves away from you, you may follow them and roll your single status die as a Hinder against them.

name: Prey on the Weak
game_text: Attack and Hinder using [quality]. If the target has: a or less status die, use your Max+Min dice; a status die, use your Max die; larger than a , use your Mid die.

name: Repeated Punishment
game_text: After making an Attack action on your turn, use your Mid die to make another Attack against one target of the initial Attack.

name: Too Close for Comfort
game_text: Whenever a nearby opponent would Attack you, you may destroy a bonus on yourself or a penalty on that opponent to reduce the Attack by the value of the destroyed mod.

name: Twist the Knife
game_text: When one of your allies Attacks an opponent, roll your single [quality] die and add that amount of damage to the Attack.

name: Up in Your Face
game_text: Attack using [quality]. Use your Max die. If the target does not Attack you on their next turn, Hinder them using your Mid die.

name: Best in the Biz
game_text: Hinder using [power]. Use your Min die. Boost yourself using your Max die.

name: Dodge and Weave
game_text: When Attacked, Defend yourself by rolling your single [quality] die. Deal that much damage to another target.

name: Consistently Capable
game_text: Whenever you gain a penalty, reduce the size of that penalty by 1.

name: Flexible Expertise
game_text: Take any basic action using your Max die. Recover Health equal to your Mid die.

name: Incomparable Inequity
game_text: Hinder using [quality] and use your Max+Min dice. This penalty is persistent and exclusive.

name: Misdirection
game_text: Hinder multiple targets using [quality] and use your Max die. If you roll doubles, also Attack each target with your Mid die. Specialized

name: Active Cover
game_text: Defend against an Attack where you’re the only target by rolling your single [quality] die. One other nearby target takes an amount of damage equal to the damage reduced.

name: Cleaving Slash
game_text: Attack using [quality] against one target with your Max die, another with your Mid die, and a third with your Min die.

name: Focused Attack
game_text: Attack using [quality] and use your Max+Min dice. Defend yourself using your Mid die.

name: Known Target
game_text: Whenever you Attack a target that you have dealt damage to at least once already in this scene, gain a +1 persistent and exclusive bonus against that target.

name: Neutralizing Strike
game_text: Attack one target using [quality] and use your Max+Min dice. That target cannot Defend or use reactions against this attack.

name: Tangled Torment
game_text: Hinder one target using [quality] and use your Max die. Attack that target using your Mid die.

name: Group Up
game_text: Attack using [quality] and use your Max die. Add 1 to the Attack for each other ally that Attacked that target since your last turn. I’ll Back You Up R When a nearby ally makes an Attack, you may also Attack the same target by rolling your single [quality] die.

name: Joint Action
game_text: Make a basic action using [quality] and use your Max die. One nearby ally also makes that same basic action as their reaction.

name: Organized March
game_text: Boost using [quality] and use your Max die. That bonus applies to every ally’s action until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Try Again
game_text: Take 1 irreducible damage to reroll an ally’s dice pool.

name: Working Together
game_text: As long as you have at least 1 nearby ally, you may reroll all 1s on your dice. Tactician Underpowered

name: Avoid the Inevitable
game_text: Whenever you would be reduced to 0 or fewer Health, prevent that damage and reduce all your power dice by one size. If this reduces any dice to below a , you are knocked out.

name: Do Not Underestimate Me
game_text: Attack using [power]. Use your Max+Mid dice. Take irreducible damage equal to your Min die. If you roll doubles, you cannot use this ability again for the rest of the scene. I Can Do Anything A Boost using [quality]. Use your Max die. Hinder using your Mid die. Attack using your Min die.

name: Last Ditch Effort
game_text: When Attacked, Defend yourself by rolling your single [power] die. If your roll reduces the damage to exactly 0, Recover Health equal to the damage reduced, Boost using that amount, and Hinder the source of the Attack using that amount.

name: Still a Threat
game_text: Attack multiple targets using [quality]. Defend against all Attacks against you until your next turn using your Min die.
